★★★★☆

Used Kilbarrack Van Co for a move from Phibsborough to Drumcondra in October. Overall, the lads were great value and I would use them again, but there were a couple of things that make it four stars rather than five.

I was quoted €340 for two lads and the van for up to four hours. The move took about three and a half hours, which was good going considering the new place is a fourth-floor walk-up with no lift. Other quotes I got were €450 upwards, so there was a fair difference in price. Booking through the website was straightforward too.

The main issue on the day was the timing. They were booked for 9am and arrived at half ten. Dessie did text at 8.40 to say the previous job had overrun, so I wasn’t left wondering whether they were coming, but it was still a fair wait when everything was packed and ready. It wasn’t a disaster for me, apart from sitting on boxes drinking cold coffee, but if you had a tight handover with a landlord or needed to be out by a particular time, that delay could be awkward. To be fair to Dessie, he knocked €40 off afterwards without me asking, which I appreciated.

Once they got going, they worked hard. Four flights of stairs with furniture is no joke, and they got on with it. The couch wouldn’t make the turn on the third floor, which had me worried, but one of the lads had an Allen key in his pocket, took the legs off and got it straight in. That was a relief. They also put the bed back together without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn’t want. Both were a big help at the end of the move.

The disappointing bit was a chip to the base of my brass floor lamp. It had belonged to my nanny, so I was a bit gutted about that. The other furniture was wrapped in blankets, but the lamp wasn’t, and I’d have liked the same care taken with it. Worth mentioning because it does matter when you’re trusting someone with your things, even if the rest of the move goes well. Wrap the lamps, lads!

All in, I was happy with the move and the value, and I’d book them again. They handled a difficult set of stairs well and did a few helpful extras without making a fuss. My advice would be to leave some breathing room on timing and point out anything particularly fragile or sentimental before it’s loaded. Four stars feels fair for my experience: plenty of good work, with a couple of things that could have been better.
